observation.visible_scene: A large white multi-deck cruise ship with a dark funnel floats on calm, mirror-like water inside a fjord. A steep, shadowed cliff wall rises on the left, green forested slopes on the right, and a snow-capped mountain peak sits under a pale-blue sky with thin clouds in the background. A bright vertical reflection of the hull shimmers on the water directly beneath the ship, and a cyan-tinted exhaust plume rises from the funnel.
visible_changes: The ship grows steadily larger in frame and rotates from a near head-on view (bow facing the camera) to a full broadside profile with the bow pointing left and rows of lifeboats visible along the hull.
The funnel's exhaust plume changes shape: in the early frames it drifts horizontally to the right as a short, wide cloud, while in later frames it becomes a taller, thinner, near-vertical column.

The background mountain, left cliff and right slope stay in roughly the same positions and scale throughout, so the apparent change is the ship's motion (closing distance and turning to broadside) rather than a camera pan; a slight zoom-in cannot be ruled out.
The water reflection beneath the ship persists the whole time and lengthens/brightens in step with the ship's increasing size.
outside_clip_unknowns: The ship's actual heading change and maneuver (turn vs. perspective of an approach) before and after this crop.
The wind conditions driving the smoke's shift from horizontal to vertical.
Whether the size increase is purely the ship approaching or partly a camera zoom.
uncertain_details: Exact cause of the ship's apparent enlargement (proximity vs. zoom).
Precise orientation of the ship's bow relative to its travel direction.
Continuity of the smoke plume's drift direction across the boundary frames.
